author: ChankaLanka
quote: Deeply disappointing. The fears that this game would be boring female power fantasy woke slop unfortunately proved to be true. I held out hope, but it ended up being exactly as bad as I feared, but the most egregious offense is that it's BORING. Instead of coming up with something new, Rockstar just copy pasted the innovations of RDR2 onto GTA, but it doesn't work because GTA takes place in the modern world. Everything is safe, sanitized, and fun policed. The humor is PC and won't touch "protected groups". The missions are mind boggling slow and flabbergasting how anyone could have thought it was fun. The writing is astoundingly bad and you can tell the glory days of Rockstar are over. Many of the physics and mechanics are genuine downgrades from it's predecessor. The characters are as exciting as watching paint dry, which unfortunately is exactly what you do in one of the missions.
